         and not any(q.is_symlink() for q in (p,*p.parents)),'canonical_nonsymlink_route')

             'metadata_returned_bytes_or_stat_changed')
    return b,{'path':str(p),'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'stat':stamp(s)}
